title: AI Powered Webisite of UAE Government Healthcare System
summary: Emirates Health Services describes a launched AI-enabled website with chatbot, multilingual, and accessibility functions; outcome gains are unspecified.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The EHS platform combines an assistance chatbot, accessibility tools, multilingual support, and digital healthcare services. The submission describes features intended to reduce access barriers and administrative work. It does not quantify a change in staff workload, patient access, or health, and its carbon and universal-coverage claims remain broader intended effects.
purpose: Make digital healthcare information and services easier to access.

ratings.reason: Accessibility functions are available, but the source gives no measured change in use, understanding, or health for users.
Reduced staff workload is asserted as a platform mechanism, without a documented operational comparison.
Universal access and lower emissions are unmeasured intended effects.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 19: AI Powered Webisite of UAE Government Healthcare System

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: The EHS website adds AI assistance and accessibility tools

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
